conventions:
per problem, a cell's rate = mean over its samples (first attempt only). A - B = mean over problems of
(rate_A - rate_B), in points (x 100 / n problems; x 3.28 = problems on hard328, x 5.38 on Code). Interval: paired bootstrap over
problems, 10,000 resamples, numpy default_rng(0) for every interval (so all intervals of one n share resamples), percentiles
2.5/97.5 (95 %) and 0.5/99.5 (99 %). "Cut off" = cap_hit (the answer reached 16,384 generated tokens). "Finished wrong" = not cut
off and scored wrong (hard328: score_v3 0; Code: passed false, including answers with no code block). Tokens = n_new.

7_cut_off_but_right.explanation: the grader (v3) scores the last boxed answer anywhere in the text. In every such answer of the main cells' raw texts (36 answers) a \boxed{} with the right value was written before the limit (last \boxed at 0.79-1.00 of the text), and the model did not stop: it restarted the solution ('To solve the problem, ...') or kept checking ('Wait, ...') until 16,384 tokens. finish_reason is 'length' for all.

openings.rule:
the three tokens ' line', '!\n\n', 'Okay'.
      cue_opening   the text, after leading whitespace, is: an optional word 'line', then '!', then whitespace, then 'Okay'
                    (the cue's own tokens, written by the model when it is not given them; the cued cells contain them as prefix)
      okay_first    the first word after any leading punctuation and whitespace and an optional word 'line' is 'Okay' (any trailing punctuation)
      answer_first  '\boxed' occurs in the first 300 characters
      empty_or_short  fewer than 20 words in the whole answer
      first_three_words  the 8 most frequent first three whitespace words
      per_problem   problem index -> [cue_opening, okay_first, empty_or_short] (0/1)

P6.text: S1 (L22-31 x3.0). Right minus base (same seeds, samples 0 and 1 of both) has an interval including 0, and cap hits fall by at least 8 points. Refuted if S1 alone adds >= +4 points right over the base.

P7.text: Without the cue, direction 1 adds more right answers over the plain base than directions 2-8 do: S2 minus S3 >= +3 points right. Refuted if S3 adds at least as many right answers as S2 (S2 minus S3 <= 0).
